name: Primary Logic Explorers
description: A playful introduction to patterns, sorting, sequencing, riddles and explaining how an answer was reached.

name: Secondary Critical Thinkers
description: Learners evaluate claims, examine evidence, compare choices and practise making reasoned decisions.
outcome: Learners learn to support ideas with reasons.

name: Chess and Strategy Club
description: Guided chess and strategy games encourage planning, patience, anticipation and reflection after each game.

name: Puzzle and Problem-Solving Lab
description: Learners tackle logic grids, visual puzzles, jigsaws and disentanglement challenges with increasing complexity.
outcome: Learners test and refine different approaches.

name: Debate and Communication
description: Learners prepare viewpoints, listen actively, question assumptions and communicate respectfully.
outcome: Learners present ideas clearly and fairly.

name: Creative Builders
description: Using blocks and simple materials, learners design structures, test their ideas and make improvements.
outcome: Learners connect ideas with practical tests.

name: Team Challenge Sessions
description: Small groups solve shared challenges by discussing options, dividing tasks and reviewing their results.

name: Decision Skills Workshop
description: Realistic scenarios help learners identify options, weigh consequences and explain their choices.
outcome: Learners develop a deliberate decision process.

name: Visual Thinking Studio
description: Shapes, spatial puzzles and visual patterns encourage learners to notice relationships and imagine alternatives.
